skill.displayName: 个人数字资产盘点管家

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed digital-asset inventory helper with an optional, user-authorized zengzhi.life workflow, and I found no hidden execution, persistence, or exfiltration behavior.

dimensions.detail: Mode B uses network API calls and may upload user-provided evidence to zengzhi.life, which is sensitive but disclosed and proportionate to creating a platform asset report.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown instructions and references only; no executable scripts, dependency installation, tool wrapping, or local install hooks were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes some broad terms such as inventory and side-hustle, but the instructions separate no-account inventory mode from authorized platform mode and explicitly stop before publishing, listing, deeds, or deal confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill may create persistent platform records and draft page data after authorization, but it instructs agents not to store or echo API keys, supports user approval/revocation flow, and forbids public or transactional endpoints.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's capabilities match its stated purpose: it guides a user through asset inventory and, when authorized, creates platform orders, uploads user-provided materials, generates reports, and prepares a display page before public publication.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sharing your asset evidence with zengzhi.life when using Mode B. Review any authorization scope before approving it, avoid pasting unrelated private data, and perform public display, listing, signing, and sales confirmation yourself as the skill instructs.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is partially supported by the artifact, but it does not justify Review by itself because sensitive platform actions require a key or device authorization and the workflow boundaries are clearly documented.
